lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately four primary horizontal rows with distinct spacing of 40-60 pixels between the centroids of adjacent spots in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the central lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible running horizontally along the upper flank, displaying a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with specular highlights on the dorsal edge and localized shadows on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin silhouette contains a sparse distribution of approximately 10-12 high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated along the basal and medial sections of the fin's surface.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora is attached to the ventral-lateral region, positioned immediately posterior to the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
